inputs.original_text: Introduced as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, the proposed legislation would require guns sold in New York to be designed so they cannot be easily modified into illegal machine guns and would establish criminal penalties for...
inputs.modified_text:
Well, folks, look at what they’re trying to pull in New York now. Under the guise of their so-called 2026 State of the State agenda, the progressive machine in Albany is pushing yet another assault on our fundamental Second Amendment rights and personal liberties. 

They are moving forward with proposed legislation that would dictate how firearms sold in New York must be designed, supposedly to prevent them from being modified, while slapping even more heavy-handed criminal penalties on law-abiding citizens. This is classic government overreach—instead of focusing on personal responsibility, law and order, and holding actual criminals accountable, the ruling elites want to tinker with manufacturers and restrict the freedoms of decent, hard-working people who just want to protect their families and homes. It’s an insult to our traditions and another step toward eroding our constitutional heritage.
